endangerment.comment: Saam (5327-raq) = Severely Endangered (20 percent certain, based on the evidence available) [ed. 2010](cldf:ed:10)

hh_ethnologue_comment.comment:
E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 har an entry for a separate language Saam [raq] in the Irkhuwa-valley of Nepal. However, recent fieldwork has shown this to be an extinct dialect of (Western) Mewahang [raf],
not a separate language (**hh:sv:Gerber:Oberarun**:16, 25-28). See also: Western Mewahang [raf].
